summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a 6-K compiling September 2026 RNS disclosures, chiefly share buybacks under its programme announced 18 March 2024 and authorized at the 15 April 2026 AGM. Goldman Sachs International purchased ordinary shares across multiple dates, with volume-weighted average prices around 4,136-4,193 pence, and BAT intends to cancel them. Following cancellation, 2,159,784,896 shares carry voting rights, with 132,648,864 held in treasury. Other exhibits cover voting rights, share issuance, director dealings and a quarterly dividend. Watch execution pace, cancellation cadence and any capital markets day updates.
